g.text: More small-group coverage can come with a delay
Batch n=250, shift=1.4 SD; 40 streams per share. Ordinary tests require 50 records per batch; accumulation requires 100 per block. Undetected
targets are assigned the 15-batch horizon, not dropped. Delay intervals describe a restricted mean; coverage uses Wilson intervals.
